name: Holiday Calculator
tagline: Find public holidays and calculate days until the next one
description: Browse public holidays for 20+ countries. Find the next upcoming holiday, calculate how many days until it, and see all holidays for the current and next year. No login required.
metaTitle: Holiday Calculator – Public Holidays & Days Until Next Holiday
metaDescription: Find public holidays for 20+ countries. Calculate days until your next holiday. Free holiday calculator — US, UK, Australia, Canada, and more.

faqs.question: Which countries are supported?
faqs.answer: 20+ countries including US, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, France, Japan, India, and more.

faqs.question: How is the days countdown calculated?
faqs.answer: The tool calculates the difference between today's date and each upcoming holiday, updating at midnight.

variants.metaTitle: US Public Holidays 2025 – Federal Holiday Calendar
variants.metaDescription: Complete list of US federal public holidays in 2025. Find all official US holiday dates, days of the week, and days until each holiday. Free US holiday calendar.
variants.headline: Complete list of US federal holidays in 2025. Find the exact date, day of the week, and countdown for every official American public holiday.

variants.metaTitle: UK Public Holidays 2025 – Bank Holidays England, Scotland, Wales
variants.metaDescription: Complete list of UK bank holidays in 2025 for England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Find all official UK public holiday dates and countdowns.
variants.headline: Complete list of UK bank holidays in 2025. Covers England & Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland separately — because not all regions share the same holidays.

variants.metaTitle: Days Until Christmas 2025 – Christmas Countdown Calculator
variants.metaDescription: Find out how many days until Christmas 2025. Real-time Christmas countdown with hours, minutes, and seconds. Free Christmas days calculator.
variants.headline: How many days until Christmas 2025? See the exact countdown in days, hours, minutes, and seconds — updated in real time.
